title: DLMF 5.12 Beta Function: In this section all fractional powers have their principal values, except where noted otherwise.
summary: DLMF 5.12 Beta Function: In this section all fractional powers have their principal values, except where noted otherwise.
body: NIST DLMF section 5.12 (Beta Function) says: "In this section all fractional powers have their principal values, except where noted otherwise. In ( 5.12.1 )–( 5.12.4 ) it is assumed \Re a>0 and \Re b>0 . In ( 5.12.8 ) the fractional powers have their principal values when w>0 and z>0 , and are continued via continuity. with the contour as shown in Figure 5.12.1 . In ( 5.12.11 ) and ( 5.12.12 ) the fractional powers are continuous on the integration paths and take their principal values at the beginning. when \Re b>0 , a is not an integer and the contour cuts the real axis between -1 and the origin. See Figure 5.12.2 . where the contour starts from an arbitrary point P in the interval (0,1) , circles 1 and then 0 in the positive sense, circles 1 and then 0 in the negative sense, and returns to P . It can always be deformed into the contour shown in Figure 5.12.3 ." Equation 5.12.1 on the page has alt text "\mathrm{B}\left(a,b\right)=\int_{0}^{1}t^{a-1}(1-t)^{b-1}\,\mathrm{d}t=\frac{% \Gamma\left(a\right)\Gamma\left(b\right)}{\Gamma\left(a+b\right)}.". Equation 5.12.2 on the page has alt text "\int_{0}^{\pi/2}{\sin}^{2a-1}\theta{\cos}^{2b-1}\theta\,\mathrm{d}\theta=% \tfrac{1}{2}\mathrm{B}\left(a,b\right).". This card records that section's wording and equation alt text. It does not retypeset a formula the alt text did not carry.
